HitDieConfig.Title: Hit Die Configuration
HitDieConfig.SizeMapHelp: Default hit die used by monsters set to "From Size". Changes apply to existing monsters using "From Size" automatically.
HitDieConfig.FallbackLabel: Apply size→die map to bestiary NPCs without authored flags
HitDieConfig.FallbackHelp: When ON, dragging a compendium NPC onto the scene rolls HP using the size→die map. When OFF (default), bestiary NPCs use the legacy HD × 4.5 formula.
HitDieConfig.MenuHint: Edit the size→die map and bestiary fallback used for HP rolling.
